mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows, which compresses forward discounting and boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline by 1% over the next 3 months, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in a t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An employment surge exceeding 150,000 in PAYEMS indicates a robust labor market, fostering consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS does not cross 150,000 threshold, or 5-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signal robust economic growth, amplifying corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase over the next month
failure_condition: If proxies do not move in tandem, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), higher discount rates on equity valuations compress forward returns, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS do not rise consistently, or 20-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO beyond 108 signals robust production capacity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not exceed 108, or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3%) coupled with rising PAYEMS indicates labor market stability, fostering consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If proxies do not move as expected, or 5-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion phase (GDPC1 > 11000), elevated demand pressures equity valuations upward, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 does not exceed 11000, or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in INDPRO beyond current levels signals robust production, enhancing corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO does not rise, or 5-day returns are negative.
